name: BMW F800GS
engine: 798 cc liquid-cooled parallel twin, fuel injected, chain drive
intro: A capable mid-size GS. The water pump seal is the known weak spot. Watch the weep hole.

add.title: Check the water pump weep hole
add.instructions: Look under the water pump for coolant drips from the weep hole. Check the oil for a milky look.
add.reason: Worn water pump seals are a known fault on the 800 twins.

recallNote: No recalls found for these years when this course was written. Run your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls to be sure.

known.title: Water pump seals
known.what: Owners say the water pump seals fail and leak from the weep hole on the 800 twin engines.
